meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成微信个人号消息收发，无需付费Token
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将微信个人号接入自动化流程
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WeChat personal account messaging without paid tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect WeChat personal account to automation workflows

howto.what: 安装后,NanoClaw 会把个人微信当作一个渠道:扫码登录后,别人发给这个微信的消息会进入已绑定的 agent 组,由机器人自动回复;无需配置 API 密钥或 Webhook。
howto.when: 当你想把个人微信账号接入 NanoClaw、说“添加微信”或“连接我的微信”时触发。

say.text: 帮我接入个人微信,绑定到默认 agent 组
say.note: 执行安装并提示扫码登录

say.text: 把微信渠道加到当前 agent 组
say.note: 会运行 wire-dm.ts 完成绑定

say.text: 微信登录过期了,帮我重新生成二维码
say.note: 删除 auth.json 并重启服务

howto.what_en: After installation, NanoClaw treats your personal WeChat as a channel: after QR login, messages sent to this WeChat enter the bound agent group and the bot replies automatically; no API key or webhook is needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a personal WeChat channel, e.g. saying 'add WeChat' or 'connect my WeChat account'.

say_en.text: Add my personal WeChat and bind it to the default agent group.
say_en.note: Runs the install flow and asks you to scan the QR code.

say_en.text: Wire the WeChat channel to the current agent group.
say_en.note: Runs wire-dm.ts to complete the wiring.

say_en.text: WeChat session expired; regenerate the login QR code.
say_en.note: Deletes auth.json and restarts the service.
